CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_logout_v147(p_session_token text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
update public.admin_sessions_v147
set revoked_at = now()
where token_hash =
digest(coalesce(p_session_token, ''), 'sha256')
and revoked_at is null;

return found;
end;
$function$
